verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents percentage rollouts, scheduled flags, and Release Pipelines that move flags through stages automatically using triggers and actions. It also has an experimentation engine that reads A/B results. None of the evidence shows a rollout guarded by health or regression metrics, or a release that rolls back automatically when a metric degrades. The pipeline triggers are never described as metric-based, and the experimentation results are not tied to any automatic rollback, so the core of this story is unevidenced.
